verdict.rationale: DPMA's online services (DEPATISnet, DPMAregister, DPMAdirektWeb/Pro) could plausibly offer event-triggered rules or monitoring, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only search, register lookup, and electronic or paper filing routes, with nothing on user-defined rules that fire actions automatically on events. Accelerated examination is a one-off request, not a recurring automated trigger.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
